issues.observed: The exact owner-local initial edge targets Accelerating.
issues.reason: The exact InMotion-owned initial edge targets Accelerating.
issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The owner-scoped transition satisfies the obligation.
issues.title: Motion-begins initial entry

issues.basis: NL8 state_action contract, state:Accelerating:line:11, and the closed action inventory with no lifecycle action row.
issues.expected: Accelerating must perform Accelerate on entry.
issues.observed: No entry action is present on the closed Accelerating state carrier.
issues.reason: The exact state, entry phase, and required action are known, but no closed entry action is present.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source annotation is not closed-model action evidence.
issues.title: Accelerating entry action absent

issues.basis: NL9, transition:line:18, and transition effects in the closed inventory.
issues.expected: Approaching must send the Send signal.
issues.observed: The closed exit transition has only R45RouteToken = 7 and no Send effect.
issues.reason: The required Send effect is absent from the closed carrier; the relevant exit transition emits only a route-token update.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source exit label does not establish a closed-model effect.
issues.title: Approaching Send effect absent

issues.basis: NL9 progress contract; Stopping no-outgoing diagnostic; Approaching outgoing transitions at lines 18, 21, and 24.
issues.expected: Approaching must have operational continuation toward the destination.
issues.observed: Approaching has outgoing transitions; Stopping is the only reported reachable leaf without outgoing transitions.
issues.reason: The supplied leaf fact concerns Stopping, while Approaching has outgoing transitions. It therefore does not establish an Approaching deadlock violation.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The no-outgoing fact has a different state locus.
issues.title: Approaching progress unsupported by Stopping leaf fact

issues.basis: NL10 retention contract, state:Approaching:line:13, and absence of an applicable supplied finite retention result.
issues.expected: Approaching must be retained while nearing the destination until ready to stop or decelerate.
issues.observed: No supplied trace fact evaluates this retention window.
issues.reason: The exact state is bound, but no supplied trace fact evaluates the specified retention window and release condition.
issues.requirement_quote: The system remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Outgoing transitions alone do not establish or refute the temporal retention requirement.
issues.title: Approaching retention unsupported

issues.basis: NL3 derived endpoint and closed transition:line:31.
issues.expected: When an obstacle is detected, a transition from InMotion to EmergencyStopping must exist.
issues.observed: The exact endpoint pair exists on transition:line:31.
issues.reason: The derived endpoint obligation is satisfied by the exact parent transition.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The complete closed inventory confirms the endpoint.
issues.title: Obstacle transition endpoint present

issues.basis: NL3 derived trigger contract; source transition tr_0009; closed transition:line:31 with empty triggers and guard R45RouteToken == 9; obstacle child consumers transition:line:22 through transition:line:24.
issues.expected: The InMotion-to-EmergencyStopping transition must be triggered by obstacle detection.
issues.observed: The exact parent transition has no trigger and uses guard R45RouteToken == 9.
issues.reason: The exact parent transition has no trigger and is selected by an internal route-token guard, whereas the source requires obstacle detection as its trigger.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Obstacle_Detected is declared and consumed by child transitions, but the exact parent endpoint carrier is not directly triggered by it.
issues.title: Obstacle trigger mismatch
